summary:
Frontend-only verification of the TWO changes for TomeForge card detail: (1) BUG FIX — mirrored/reversed text on the exported card BACK, and (2) FEATURE — CardFront quick-reference stat chips + line-clamp-2 description. ALL 7 acceptance criteria PASS. Login mago@grimorio.it/arcano123 -> /collezione (5 seeded cards). Opened /carta/ for 'Dardo Incantato' (spell). CardFront quick-stats verified in the visible DOM: LIVELLO=1, AZIONE=Azione, GITTATA=36 m, AREA=-, CONCENTRAZIONE=No, DANNO=3d4+3 forza. Description on front is the short italic paragraph 'Tre dardi di forza magica colpiscono senza fallire.' inside a

— confirmed line-clamp-2 CSS present. Flip button toggles rotateY(180) and CardBack shows TOMEFORGE emblem readable on screen. CORE REGRESSION VERIFIED: pdf-btn triggered a real browser download 'Dardo Incantato-fronte-retro.pdf' (3.88 MB, 2 pages, PDF format [63.5,88.9] mm). Rendered both pages with PyMuPDF at 250 DPI. Page 1 = front (artwork + QuickStats + QR, all upright). Page 2 = back — 'TOMEFORGE' reads left-to-right, the flame emblem is upright, 'MAGIA' type label is upright and correctly oriented. Text is NOT mirrored/reversed. Bug fix is CONFIRMED. share-btn downloaded 'Dardo Incantato.png' (465 KB, valid \x89PNG signature) — front image upright, not reversed. Regression on /carta/ for character 'Elarion il Saggio' PASSES: slot-minus-0 decreases slot, slot-plus-0 restores it, long-rest-btn resets. sheet-btn downloaded 'scheda-Elarion il Saggio.pdf' (10.7 MB, valid %PDF- header, A4). Two success sonner toasts observed after PDF+PNG on spell (Immagine esportata / PDF generato / Scheda A4 generata). Zero pageerror, zero error toasts across the entire session. Skills loaded: none (no AI capability in scope for this UI/export regression).

issues: Card TITLE (h3 with class 'tf-gold-text', likely using -webkit-background-clip: text / background-image on text) renders as faint/blank grey on the gold header bar in the html2canvas output. The character name 'Dardo Incantato' is essentially invisible in the exported PNG and PDF page 1. This appears to be a pre-existing html2canvas limitation with CSS text gradients (background-clip: text) and is unrelated to the mirroring bug fix, but it should be flagged: the printed card front does not show the card name legibly. Suggested fix (main agent): use a solid gold color (e.g. text-gold) instead of tf-gold-text on the CardFront <h3>, or force a fallback text color inside an @media/print block used only for the off-screen exportFrontRef/exportBackRef nodes.

action_items: Consider making the CardFront <h3> name legible in html2canvas exports (replace tf-gold-text gradient with a solid gold color for the off-screen export copies, or apply a print-mode class on exportFrontRef/exportBackRef nodes). Not blocking the bug fix but affects PDF/PNG usefulness.
critical_code_review_comments: CardDetail.jsx (lines 173-203): shareImage and exportPDF now capture exportFrontRef / exportBackRef which are off-screen with no 3D transform — this is the correct fix. Both refs are rendered inside a position:fixed left:-99999 wrapper, which keeps them present but off-screen. Good.

The off-screen export div renders <CardFront card={card} /> and <CardBack card={card} /> using width:340px + aspectRatio '2.5/3.5'. There are now TWO card-front and TWO card-back nodes in DOM at all times on the detail page, which is intentional but slightly increases render cost; a small perf/mem note only.

html2canvas rendering of the front title uses tf-gold-text (CSS text-gradient via background-clip:text). html2canvas does not render this reliably — the exported card name becomes invisible. Suggest a fallback for the export copies only.

Both fronts (visible + hidden export) share the same data-testid='card-front' and 'card-back'. Automation must select the first (visible) node explicitly (as done here); consider distinct testids like 'card-front-export' to avoid ambiguity in future tests.
seed_data_creation: None (used the 5 pre-seeded cards, including spell 'Dardo Incantato' and character 'Elarion il Saggio').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Card detail page /carta/<id>: TWO 'card-front' and TWO 'card-back' nodes exist in DOM (visible flip + off-screen export copies). Always target locator('[data-testid="card-front"]').first for on-screen checks. Exports produce real browser downloads captured via page.expect_download: pdf-btn -> '<name>-fronte-retro.pdf' (2 pages, 63.5x88.9 mm), share-btn -> '<name>.png' (front only), sheet-btn -> 'scheda-<name>.pdf' (A4, character only). To verify the mirroring bug: render PDF pages with PyMuPDF (fitz.open(path).load_page(1).get_pixmap(dpi=250).save(...)) and inspect page 2 — 'TOMEFORGE' must read left-to-right. Rendering takes 5-15s per html2canvas call (canvas2D 'willReadFrequently' warnings are benign). Known cosmetic quirk: card <h3> uses tf-gold-text CSS text-gradient which html2canvas does NOT render — the card name appears missing in exported PDF/PNG.
rca of the issue: Original bug: shareImage/exportPDF captured the visible flip <motion.div rotateY(180deg)> back face directly with html2canvas. Because the ancestor had a 3D transform applied, html2canvas rendered the raster in a mirrored orientation (text like TOMEFORGE came out backwards on the exported PDF page). Fix (verified in CardDetail.jsx): the two capture targets exportFrontRef/exportBackRef are now separate off-screen renders of <CardFront/> and <CardBack/> in a plain <div style='position:fixed; left:-99999'> with NO rotateY / no preserve-3d ancestor. html2canvas therefore rasterizes them in their natural upright orientation; jsPDF adds each raster on its own page. Verified end-to-end by rendering the downloaded PDF back page (page 2) with PyMuPDF at 250 DPI — text and emblem are upright and readable. No mirror artifact remains.
